description: This file defines data structures, methods, and constants related to product notices in the Mattermost application, including serialization, conditions, audience targeting, and external dependencies.

classes.name: ProductNotices
classes.description: A slice of ProductNotice objects representing multiple notices.

classes.name: ProductNotice
classes.description: Represents a single product notice with conditions, ID, localized messages, and repeatability flag.

classes.name: Conditions
classes.description: Defines various conditions under which a notice is shown, such as audience, client type, version ranges, and server/user configurations.

classes.name: NoticeMessageInternal
classes.description: Contains the content and actions of a notice message, including title, description, image, and optional action.

classes.name: NoticeMessage
classes.description: Represents a notice message with internal content and visibility flags for admin roles.

classes.name: NoticeAudience
classes.description: String type defining user roles for notice visibility, such as 'all', 'member', 'sysadmin', 'teamadmin'.

classes.name: NoticeClientType
classes.description: String type indicating client platforms like 'all', 'desktop', 'mobile', 'web', etc.

classes.name: NoticeInstanceType
classes.description: String type indicating instance types like 'both', 'cloud', 'onprem'.

classes.name: NoticeSKU
classes.description: String type for SKU targeting, such as 'all', 'e0', 'e10', 'e20', 'team'.

classes.name: NoticeAction
classes.description: String type for actions on notices, e.g., 'url'.

classes.name: ProductNoticeViewState
classes.description: Tracks the 'viewed' state of notices per user, including timestamp.

classes.name: ExternalDependency
classes.description: Represents an external dependency with name and minimum version.

methods.name: UnmarshalProductNoticeMessages
methods.description: Decodes JSON data from an io.Reader into NoticeMessages.

methods.name: Matches
methods.description: Checks if the NoticeAudience matches given admin roles.

methods.name: Matches
methods.description: Checks if the NoticeClientType matches another type.

methods.name: NoticeClientTypeFromString
methods.description: Converts a string to a NoticeClientType.

methods.name: Matches
methods.description: Checks if the NoticeInstanceType matches cloud/on-prem conditions.

methods.name: Matches
methods.description: Checks if the NoticeSKU matches a given SKU string.
